_doc: Small-indicator battery table. Single source of truth for regex tells (small strings that instantly signal a vuln class). Add a row when you learn one (engagement close-out, research ingest); keep patterns HIGH-PRECISION (a noisy tell trains the eye to ignore the battery). class/skill route the hit; note says what to read next.

tells.note: raw-HTML sink; read the render block + trace what feeds it
JS eval sink (client XSS); eval( in SERVER code = RCE, re-route
command-exec sink; trace the argument back to input
string-built SQL; read the query builder + param flow
deser sink; identify the gadget library + who controls the blob
server-side fetch; check whether the URL is user-influenced
XML parser; XXE unless entities disabled - check parser config
SSTI surface; check whether template source is user-controlled
redirect/file send on request input; traversal or open-redirect
hard key/JWT material; capture verbatim, test scope of use
hardcoded credential-ish assignment; verify it is not a placeholder
env-style secret name; read the value + where it is committed
HTML comment hint; read the whole comment block
stack trace in output; harvest paths/versions/SQL from it
version banner; fingerprint -> playbook.json targeted tests
debug mode flag; debug mode = stack traces + code exec surfaces
framework raw-HTML/sanitizer-bypass sink (Angular/Jinja/Rails); trace the bound value
PHP RFI/LFI on request input, or a webshell signature; read the include path
PHP/Go command-exec sink; trace the argument back to input
ORM-raw or string-built SQL (Node/Java); read the query builder + param flow
weak JWT verification config; forge/bypass path
vendor token SHAPE (GitHub/Slack/Stripe/Google/GitLab); capture verbatim, test its scope
fork-trigger workflow; does it check out the fork HEAD near secrets?
untrusted template context / OIDC write in a workflow; workflow-injection surface
PHP phar / Java XMLDecoder-readObject deser sink; who controls the input
weak hash over creds/sessions; offline-crack path
CODE trusts XFF (only meaningful in source, not saved requests); IP-spoof/auth-bypass surface
wildcard CORS; check Allow-Credentials + what the endpoint reflects

NoSQL/Mongo error oracle; operator-injection surface
LDAP/XPath error oracle; filter-injection surface
template-engine parse error; SSTI - echo a template expression and watch it evaluate
XML parser error; XXE candidate - check whether entities resolve
Java deser runtime error; your bytes ARE reaching the parser - gadget-confirm
cache layer present; probe unkeyed headers (X-Forwarded-Host etc.) for poisoning
product + version banner; straight to known-CVE lookup (context7/wiki) before novel hunting
API schema exposure; enumerate every endpoint then BOLA/BFLA the object ids
JWT session in a cookie; decode it, check alg + claims (role swap, user id)
potato-family privesc rights; saved whoami /all output confirms it
MSI install as SYSTEM; check both HKLM+HKCU registry values are 1, then msiexec the payload
sudoers NOPASSWD entry; GTFOBins the allowed binary for a shell
delegation/AS-REP material in enum output; constrained-delegation abuse or roast the account
postMessage handler; check whether origin is validated before the data hits a sink
